reuse.why: All rules are added to the existing isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories selection, the new action reuses getMonthFillCategories, averageToBudget and getSheetValue, and the tag check reuses extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: The rule logic lives once, but the new goal_def/group-notes columns and the notes join are added to two parallel SQL queries (getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories).

placement.why: Category selection rules stay in the shared selection predicate in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered alongside its siblings in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Only the selection rules, the new action, its registration and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: One predicate governs every month-wide action with a single explicit includeHiddenCategories option; the only friction is keeping the two feeding queries in sync.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories threaded through isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories (a requested option); the template and #fixed rules are general branches of the shared predicate used by every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending.
